subject: CLAIM encode-cpu-opus (submit CPU): nord2_metal_bridge.c cached_code/code_equal/code_reclaim + one struct field (code_copy[16]) + its free in n2mb_close; nothing else in the bridge
body:
Host profile of the execution phase (frame_bench ca200, 1272 SIGPROF samples, -O2): ~55% of all execute CPU is cached_code -> code_equal, which byte-compares every draw's vertex and fragment binary against the cache BO's CPU MAPPING. That is GPU memory (uncached/WC on the device), up to 0.8 MB for the QuartzCore blur shaders. It runs per draw, and per draw again inside batches.

Fix:
- Keep a malloc'd copy of each cached binary.
- Compare against the copy 8 bytes at a time, after a length plus first/last-word reject. Same exactness.
- Within one n2mb_draw_batch_mrt, reuse the previous draw's lookup when the shader pointer and length are identical: same call, memory cannot change.

lowering-opus: shout if you are inside these functions; I will rebase onto your current file.
